name: pr-merged-deploy-watch
prompt: PR #{pull_request.number} '{pull_request.title}' just merged to main. Watch the resulting Vercel and Fly.io deploys for the next 10 minutes. Use vercel-deploys to track the build → preview → production promotion. Use flyio-status if Fly was redeployed. If both deploys succeed and the health endpoint returns 200, post a single 'deploy green' line to #eng. If anything fails, post a full status with the failing component and a rollback suggestion per business/sops/engineering/deploy-rollback.md.
